name: Buds Notifier
description:
Popup cards for your Bluetooth earbuds and headsets, for every paired headset with no setup:
* Connected, with battery (left / right / case with the optional BudsLink app from Flathub)
* Disconnected
* Low battery
* Nearby: a paired headset is close but not connected, with a Connect button

The nearby card needs a Bluetooth adapter with hardware advertisement filtering and BlueZ experimental features; the preferences show whether yours is ready and the one-time command if not.
